blocks.source: ｸﾘｱ日
blocks.translation: Date Cleared

blocks.source: 旧スクウェアのやや知名度が低いながら、密かな人気を誇る良作アクションＲＰＧ。今はＰＳ３のダウンロードによって、６００円強でプレイ可能。便利な世の中になったものです。
blocks.translation: A fine action RPG from the former Square, with a low profile but a quietly devoted following. It can now be played for just over 600 yen by downloading it on the PS3. What a convenient world we live in.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Volume / Story

blocks.source: 二人の主人公が『遺産』を求めて冒険する。
blocks.translation: Two protagonists set out on an adventure in search of the “legacy.”

blocks.source: 一緒に暮らしていた女性を助けるために遺産を探すルウ。傍若無人の振る舞いの果てに、国を追放された王女ミント。この片方を選択してプレイする。
blocks.translation: Rue searches for the legacy to save a woman he once lived with. Mint is a princess banished from her country after behaving outrageously. You choose one of them to play.

blocks.source: 特にミントのキャラがハジケていて面白い。目的は世界征服。自分の欲求のままに遺産を手に入れようと、迷いなく突き進む様は爽快。世の中、優等生主人公ばかりでは面白くない。たまにはこういうキャラクターもいないと。
blocks.translation: Mint in particular is a wonderfully outrageous and entertaining character. Her goal is world domination. Watching her charge ahead without hesitation, determined to obtain the legacy in pursuit of her own desires, is exhilarating. The world would be boring if it were full of model-student protagonists. We need characters like this once in a while.

blocks.source: その他にも個性的なキャラクターが多数登場。様々な場面で二人と関わってくる。
blocks.translation: Many other distinctive characters also appear. They become involved with the two protagonists in various situations.

blocks.source: 冒険できる町は一つのみで、プレイ時間はそんなに長くない。二人合わせても、２０時間足らずといったところ。ストーリーもダンジョンの内容も大半が被っているし、ラスボスも同じ。
blocks.translation: There is only one town to explore, and the playtime is not very long. Even playing both characters takes less than 20 hours. Most of the story and dungeon content overlaps, and the final boss is the same.

blocks.source: とはいえ、少しだけ展開が違うし視点の違いは面白い。真面目なルウ編に対して、ミント編はコミカルなので落差に吹き出す。両方をクリアすると、エンディングに追加シーンあり。
blocks.translation: That said, some of the developments differ, and the change in perspective is interesting. Whereas Rue’s story is serious, Mint’s is comedic, so the contrast often made me burst out laughing. Clearing both stories unlocks an additional ending scene.

blocks.source: どことなく、ダーククロニクルと雰囲気が似ている。少年少女のコンビな上に、デザインもやや似。もちろん、こっちのほうが先発。
blocks.translation: It somehow has a similar atmosphere to Dark Chronicle. It features a boy-and-girl duo, and the designs are also somewhat similar. Of course, this game came first.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: System / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: 基本的には走って、跳んで、殴ってのオーソドックスなアクション。ＲＰＧらしく、能力の強化手段も存在するので、苦手な人でも戦闘はどうにかなる感じ。
blocks.translation: At its core, it is a traditional action game of running, jumping, and punching. As befits an RPG, there are also ways to enhance your abilities, so even people who are not good at action games should be able to manage the battles somehow.

blocks.source: ルウは魔物変身。ミントは魔法が使用できる。それぞれ、使用できる能力に応じた謎解きがある。
blocks.translation: Rue can transform into monsters, while Mint can use magic. Each character has puzzles that make use of their respective abilities.

blocks.source: ただ、もう少し戦闘においても、能力を活用する機会があれば面白かった思う。特にルウの場合はボス戦でも、変身なしで通常攻撃というのが多かったので。
blocks.translation: Still, I think it would have been more interesting if there had been more opportunities to use those abilities in battle. In Rue’s case especially, many boss fights could be handled with regular attacks without transforming.

blocks.source: ミントの魔法はルウの変身より強く、こっちのほうが使いやすい。
blocks.translation: Mint’s magic is stronger than Rue’s transformations and is easier to use.

blocks.source: 魔法の種類はたくさんあるけど選択は少し手間。○ボタンを押しながら、『色』と『効果』の組み合わせを上下左右で切り替えてから、△ボタンで発動――という手順はさすがに複雑か。
blocks.translation: There are many types of magic, but selecting them is a little cumbersome. You hold the ○ button, switch between combinations of “color” and “effect” with the directional buttons, and then activate the spell with the △ button—isn’t that procedure a bit too complicated?

blocks.source: 強いボスというよりも、倒し方のよく分からないボスに苦しめられた。ラスボスはどうやってダメージを与えればよいか分からなかったので、攻略法を見てしまった。無念……。１～２分に一回しか、ダメージチャンスがないって……。
blocks.translation: Rather than powerful bosses, I was troubled by bosses whose defeat methods were difficult to figure out. I could not work out how to damage the final boss, so I ended up looking up the strategy. What a shame... There is only one chance to deal damage every one or two minutes...?

blocks.source: ザコはそんなに強くない。どちらかというと物量で押してくる。登場して５秒足らずで瞬殺されるベヒーモスとか何たるざま。
blocks.translation: The regular enemies are not particularly strong. If anything, they overwhelm you with numbers. What a sorry sight for a Behemoth to be instantly slaughtered less than five seconds after appearing.

blocks.source: 一番気になったのがジャンプ周りの操作性。
blocks.translation: What bothered me most was the handling of jumps.

blocks.source: ジャンプアクションが多めだけど、足場の判定は結構厳しい。ちょっと意地悪に思うところがいくつかあった。
blocks.translation: There are quite a lot of jumping sections, but the collision detection for the platforms is fairly strict. A few parts felt a little mean-spirited.

blocks.source: 視点も少し分かりにくく、全体的に視点が近すぎて画面が狭く感じる。カメラ操作がＬＲでできるけど、ダンジョン内では使用不可能。というか、使用できる場所が少ないのでカメラ操作できたことを忘れるレベル。
blocks.translation: The perspective is also somewhat difficult to read, and the camera is generally so close that the screen feels cramped. You can control the camera with L and R, but this is impossible inside dungeons. In fact, there are so few places where it can be used that you may forget the camera controls even exist.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: 初代ＰＳにしては綺麗なほうだと思うけど、ポリゴンの粗さはさすがに気になるかも。３Ｄのポリゴンは、次世代と比較すれば機種の差が物凄く出るから、古い作品はどれも厳しい。
blocks.translation: I think it looks quite good for the original PlayStation, though the roughness of the polygons may be hard to ignore. With 3D polygons, the difference between platforms becomes extremely apparent when compared with the next generation, so older games all have a tough time.

blocks.source: とはいえ、このゲームについてはその粗さがキャラのかわいらしさにつながっているようにも思う。キャラクターの衣装はこっていて。頭身の低さもいい味出している。
blocks.translation: That said, in this game, I feel that the roughness also contributes to the characters’ charm. A lot of care went into the characters’ outfits, and their short proportions have a charm of their own.

blocks.source: ちなみに、このゲームはスクウェアお得意のムービーに頼っておらず、イベントシーンもポリゴンで演出されている。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, this game does not rely on the prerendered movies Square was known for; even its event scenes are presented using polygons.

blocks.source: そのイベントシーンの演出力はさすがのもので、ＰＳではかなり高い部類。キャラのジェスチャーやカメラワークなどに細かいこだわりが見られる。
blocks.translation: The direction of those event scenes is excellent, ranking among the best on the PlayStation. You can see meticulous attention to detail in the characters’ gestures, camera work, and more.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 悪くないけど、強く印象に残るという感じではない。町の曲とかは結構好き。ただ曲数自体控えめで、１ループが短い曲も目立つ。
blocks.translation: It is not bad, but it does not leave a particularly strong impression. I quite like the town music, though. The overall number of tracks is modest, however, and there are noticeably quite a few with short loops.

blocks.source: 総評
blocks.translation: Overall Verdict

blocks.source: 明るい世界観と可愛らしいキャラクターの楽しいアクションＲＰＧ。
blocks.translation: A fun action RPG with a bright world and charming characters.

blocks.source: 万人向け――といいたいところだけど、ジャンプアクションだけはちょっと辛いかもしれない。
blocks.translation: I would like to call it suitable for everyone, but the jumping sections may be a little tough for some players.
